name: cd-payroll-social
description: Prepare a DR Congo employer payroll and CNSS research workpaper for 2026. Use it to distinguish employee withholding from employer contributions, classify ordinary workers and special categories, build the supported CNSS remuneration base, allocate pension, family and occupational-risk contributions, and prepare monthly declarations and payments. It includes the exceptional expatriate-employer levy, the separate annual salary report, filing evidence and two recomputing cases covering ordinary payroll and a late-payment control decision. The carried tax-law chain, complete contribution-order chain, minimum wage, INPP and ONEM levies, special workers, monthly IRPP implementation and authenticated submission remain held. These calculations are conditional source demonstrations, not a completed payslip, final liability or filing.
